messages:
mai: Pushed a micro-proto: token list uses compact chips with icon actions. Main goals: reduce vertical density, make copy explicit, and provide safer revoke patterns. attaching GIF.

oliver: Nice. Implementation Q: is the chip focusable or just the icons? keyboard users need predictable tab stops.

lina: Proposal: chip is single focus target that opens details; copy and overflow are tabbable inside. That way arrow keys move between chips and Tab drills into actions.

design-bot: Accessibility nit: ensure the copy button has aria-label=\"Copy token to clipboard\" and do not place secret text inside any aria-live region. For reveal use role=dialog with explicit confirmation.

joel: UX copy: change primary action from \"Revoke\" to \"Disable\". Add a secondary label \"Permanently delete\" inside advanced settings to reduce fear.

mai: For rotate, ops asked to avoid accidental mass-rotates. Suggest \"Schedule rotate\" -> inline pending pill for 10s with a cancel link before we enqueue.

oliver: Make sure inline pill doesn't change layout height. Use fixed-height placeholder. Mobile: collapse to details modal.

lina: Bulk revoke edge-case: if some tokens are mid-rotation, the bulk modal should list conflicts and require per-row confirmation. No blanket success toast.

design-bot: Microcopy suggestion for empty state: \"No API tokens yet. Create one to start calling Redwood APIs.\" Primary CTA: \"Create token\". Secondary: \"Learn about scopes\". Hint: press C to create.

sam: QA checklist: keyboard nav order, SR announcements (copy -> \"Key copied\"), focus return after dialog close, undo toast (5s, keyboard-focusable), no secret text in alerts.

mai: Action items: @oliver add keyboard e2e, @lina draft scope-summary tooltip copy, @joel update revoke copy, @design-bot produce updated compact comps. I'll iterate the proto and share tomorrow. :thumbsup:
